display.title: Capstone: The End Compass
display.subtitle: Forged from the Deep Aether
description: The Eye of Ender will not serve you here. To even target the End
portal, you must first work Tier 4's first dimension - the Deep Aether -
and forge an End Compass from its materials.
Reach the Deep Aether below to begin. The End Compass points the way to
an End Bastion: the gateway structure that anchors the stronghold
search, so the End is genuinely POST-Deep-Aether.
§7The End Compass item, its Deep-Aether recipe, and the End Bastion
§7structure are still being built (progression-framework 5). For now
§7this capstone tracks reaching the Deep Aether - the prerequisite.
